tokens.v: The necklace spills from a small open leather travel case onto washed linen in low morning window light, the chain drawing one loose S-curve across the cloth and the pearl resting at its end, nacre taking a single soft highlight. 100mm macro at f/3.5 from just above the linen, the case's velvet tray and a folded silk scarf falling out of focus behind, a passport corner cut by the top-right edge. The gold peg above the pearl fires one point of light; the clasp sits open mid-frame, plain and unmarked. Linen weave reads sharp under the pearl and dissolves toward every edge.
